Shesim apartament 2+1+2 tek Rezidenca Splendor.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3.
Siperfaqja bruto e apartamentit eshte 109.14 m2 , ndersa siperfaqja neto shkon 88.86 m2 .
Objekti dorezohet brenda 16 muajve. Ne muajin dhjetor fillon vendosja e fasades.
Nje nga komplekset me te medhenj dhe potenciale ne zonen e Porcelanit, me cilesine e ndertimit me te larte.
Per me shume informacione ose nje vizite ne prone na kontakton
title_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment in Splendor, Porcelan!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment at Rezidenca Splendor. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor. The gross area of ​​the apartment is 109.14 m2, while the net area is 88.86 m2. The facility is delivered within 16 months. In December, the installation of the facade begins. One of the biggest and potential complexes in the Porcelan area, with the highest quality of construction. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us
